name: Planning & coordination
plain: The plan, the owners and this dashboard, so everyone aims at the same 3 PM demo.
next: 9 AM standup: settle the open decisions and name the e-stop person and the submission owner.
goal: Pick the stack, split the work, keep everyone pointed at the Sunday demo.

milestones.title: Open decisions settled at the 9 AM standup

name: Arm station: the can hand-off
plain: The real robot arm that takes the can from a person's hand.
next: When the station opens (about 8:30): teach the arm's poses, then 10 taped-mark and 10 hand trials before the 11:00 call.
goal: The right Maker Arm takes a can from a person's hand, or picks it from a taped mark as the backup, through our guarded controller with the operator on the e-stop.

milestones.title: Real right arm picks up an object with our guarded controller
Can hand-off routine passes its replay tests
Arm poses taught at the station
11:00 call: hand (8 of 10) or taped mark
Taught poses committed before the 11:30 freeze

risk: The can hand-off has run in replay only; the arm's poses aren't taught yet and the e-stop person isn't named.

name: Dream AI in the simulation
plain: Dream's robot AI drives the arms on the nine simulated tables.
next: Get a reliable simulated cup lift on most of the nine tables and record it for the pitch.
goal: Dream-1 drives the simulated Maker Arms in Unreal across the parallel tables; the real arm uses direct SDK control for now.

milestones.title: First Dream-driven move in the simulation
Reliable simulated cup lift on most of the nine tables

name: Turn gate: the camera check
plain: A camera check that lets the arm move only when a person is clearly offering the can.
next: Run the detector on the real camera and the real can, and check the can is seen.
goal: Watch the camera for a hand offering a can: a steady offer gives the arm its turn; an extra hand, a jerked can or a camera fault makes it wait. Gate logic is in turn_gate/, the detector in vision/.

milestones.title: Camera detector (hand + can) feeds the gate
Camera + detector latency vs 0.25 s limit
Gate pauses and resumes the arm

name: Voice agent (LiveKit)
plain: The robot speaks at the right moments, like "your turn" or "I'll wait".
next: Decide at standup whether voice is in; if so, scripted push-to-talk lines with recorded backup audio.
goal: The robot says "your turn" or "I'll wait" at the right moments.

milestones.title: Scripted voice lines with recorded backup audio

name: Simulation + human capture
plain: The simulated tables in Unreal, and the webcam and headset capture that put real people in them.
next: Run the Luna2 simulated hand-to-arm contact test and polish the parallel-table demo.
goal: Nine parallel simulated tables in Unreal, webcam and Quest capture that bring real people into them, and Isaac Sim for contact physics.

milestones.title: Arm station in the Unreal scene (now the official Maker Arm)
Hand tracking feeds the turn gate
Simulated hand-to-arm contact test on Luna2

name: Demo rehearsal & submission
plain: The 3-minute pitch, the backup video and the submission.
next: Lock the script, film the backup take after the 11:30 freeze, and start the submission by 12:30.
goal: End-to-end run on the real arm, a backup video, and the submission in by 3 PM Sunday.

milestones.title: Pitch creative + Hold My Beer script
